Hi Alyssa — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed path to unblock a pilot: 

Key notes from our call:
- Primary goal: reduce per-request inference cost and tail latency for your real-time recommendation use case.
- Current blockers: executive alignment on deployment model (dedicated vs private), security/audit expectations, and procurement timelines.
- Technical constraints: 2–4k QPS peak, 256 token median response, need for KV cache persistence across restarts.

Proposed next step: an exec-level intro (VP/CTO) + 30–45 minute technical rundown/demo to align on architecture and decision criteria. The agenda would be concise and focused on the things that matter for a procurement/exec decision:
- 10m: intro + business objectives (Marcus)
- 20m: architecture, SLA/cost tradeoffs, and deployment options (Karthik)
- 10m: security/compliance highlights + pilot success criteria (Marcus)
- 5m: confirm mutual action plan and immediate next steps

Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-08 11:00–11:45
- Wed 2026-11-09 09:30–10:15
- Thu 2026-11-10 14:00–14:45

Can you confirm which of these works for Michael (CTO) and who else should be on the call (procurement, engineering manager, security)? I attached a short draft demo agenda and a one-page mutual action plan to speed alignment. If Michael prefers, we can do a 15-minute pre-brief with him before the larger session.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate on our side once I hear back.

Best,
